# er605_read (Data Source)

Reads any router form ("get"), e.g. /admin/dhcps?form=setting. Result is the raw JSON; use jsondecode().



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) Path + form, e.g. /admin/nat?form=vs

### Optional

- `params` (String) Optional JSON object sent as params (e.g. {"start":0,"end":99} for paged lists).

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) Raw "result" JSON.
